difficulty_reason: Three equivalent acyclicity criteria for the dg-hull construction: the author first derives (3) from (1) and (2) with a local-section chase in the cokernel of N -> F(G(N)) (a closed section not in the image lifts to a boundary whose correction lies in the image of the counit), then reduces (1) and (2) to modules admitting a presentation N_1 -> N_0 -> N -> 0 with the properties for the two terms, leaving only the right-exactness deduction for the reader. Retained author proof at lines 3585-3676.
